entities.name: Material
entities.doc: A substance that elements are made of, such as a concrete or steel grade (MAT-01). Its behaviour law says how it responds to strain; its properties, in the property sets below, each cite the design-code clause they come from (REP-05).

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: The material's name, such as `C30/37` or `S355`.

attributes.name: design_code
attributes.doc: The design code the properties follow, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004`.

entities.name: Site
entities.doc: The piece of land the project stands on, and where it lies on Earth: the projected coordinate reference system, the base point, the grid rotation, the scale and an optional survey point (GEOREF-01, ADR 0017). A project has at most one site.

attributes.name: crs_epsg
attributes.doc: EPSG code of the projected coordinate reference system, such as 2154 for Lambert-93. Unset: the project is not georeferenced.

attributes.name: base_point_eastings
attributes.doc: Easting of the project base point, the origin of the local frame.

attributes.name: base_point_northings
attributes.doc: Northing of the project base point.

attributes.name: base_point_height
attributes.doc: Orthogonal height of the project base point.

attributes.name: grid_rotation
attributes.doc: Angle from the grid easting axis of the coordinate reference system to the local x-axis, counter-clockwise.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.doc: Map conversion scale from local lengths to map lengths, applied to all three axes. Finite and greater than zero.

attributes.name: survey_point_eastings
attributes.doc: Easting of the survey point, a known point such as a benchmark. Unset: no survey point.

attributes.name: survey_point_height
attributes.doc: Orthogonal height of the survey point.

properties.name: CharacteristicCompressiveStrength
properties.doc: Characteristic cylinder compressive strength at 28 days.

properties.name: CharacteristicCompressiveStrengthSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that CharacteristicCompressiveStrength comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: MeanCompressiveStrength
properties.doc: Mean cylinder compressive strength at 28 days.

properties.name: MeanCompressiveStrengthSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that MeanCompressiveStrength comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: MeanTensileStrength
properties.doc: Mean axial tensile strength.

properties.name: MeanTensileStrengthSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that MeanTensileStrength comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: StrainAtPeakStress
properties.doc: Compressive strain at which the parabola reaches the peak stress, as a ratio.

properties.name: StrainAtPeakStressSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that StrainAtPeakStress comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: UltimateCompressiveStrain
properties.doc: Ultimate compressive strain, as a ratio.

properties.name: UltimateCompressiveStrainSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that UltimateCompressiveStrain comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: ParabolaExponent
properties.doc: Exponent of the parabola of the parabola-rectangle diagram.

properties.name: ParabolaExponentSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that ParabolaExponent comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: MassDensity
properties.doc: Mass per unit volume.

properties.name: MassDensitySource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that MassDensity comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: YoungModulus
properties.doc: Modulus of elasticity; for concrete, the secant modulus.

properties.name: YoungModulusSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that YoungModulus comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: PoissonRatio
properties.doc: Ratio of lateral to axial strain under axial load.

properties.name: PoissonRatioSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that PoissonRatio comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: ThermalExpansionCoefficient
properties.doc: Linear thermal expansion, per kelvin.

properties.name: ThermalExpansionCoefficientSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that ThermalExpansionCoefficient comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: YieldStrength
properties.doc: Characteristic or nominal yield strength.

properties.name: YieldStrengthSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that YieldStrength comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: UltimateStrength
properties.doc: Characteristic or nominal ultimate tensile strength.

properties.name: UltimateStrengthSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that UltimateStrength comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: UltimateStrain
properties.doc: Strain at maximum load, as a ratio.

properties.name: UltimateStrainSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that UltimateStrain comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.

properties.name: HardeningRatio
properties.doc: Ratio of tensile strength to yield strength.

properties.name: HardeningRatioSource
properties.doc: Design-code document and clause that HardeningRatio comes from, such as `EN 1992-1-1:2004, Table 3.1`.
